segments.name: Intelligent Connectivity Platform
segments.description: Designs and sells semiconductor-based high-speed connectivity products and software for hyperscaler and OEM cloud and AI infrastructure.
segments.evidence: We have developed and deployed our leading Intelligent Connectivity Platform built from the ground up for cloud and AI infrastructure.

revenueModel.text: The company sells connectivity products in IC, board, and module form factors to distributors and end customers' manufacturing partners, primarily hyperscalers and system OEMs.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products directly to our customers and through distributors.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired aiXscale Photonics GmbH, which was allocated to the Company's single reporting unit and operating segment.
changes.evidence: on November 10, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of aiXscale Photonics GmbH ("aiXscale").
